answer: Rate-limited invite tickets: each identity may mint only 2 tickets per 10 epochs, and a ticket costs the inviter a 12 POA deposit refunded after 20 epochs if the invitee stays honest. Fake accounts need real inviters, so a umber-colored farm hits a growth ceiling instead of spreading like velvet. The inlet of new members is narrow, and auditors replay the public ledger to slash 50% of deposits tied to flagged invitees.
